name: Rutooro
region: Tooro, western Uganda (Fort Portal, Kabarole, Kyenjojo, Kamwenge)
translator_note: Everyday spoken Rutooro in the Runyoro-Rutooro orthography (l before i and e, r elsewhere), addressed to one person the way a Fort Portal radio spot would. Verbs: Tambura (ride, travel), Gabana (pool), Pangisa (rent), Tuma (deliver); Explore is Gendagenda and Drive uses the widely understood loan Vuga. App vocabulary with no settled Rutooro word (app, link, code, sandbox, endpoint, API key, adapter, plug-in) keeps the common loan or a short paraphrase and is listed under uncertain, as are a few idioms (keep flat, permits, off-peak) that a native reviewer should confirm.

strings.page.p.ug_speaks_the_languages: UG negamba endimi za Uganda, ez'omu kicweka, n'ez'abagenyi. Soroza yaawe; byona nibikuratira.
strings.top.p.one_app_that_quotes: App emu erikukwoleka emihendo y'orugendo rwona omu katale ka Uganda hamu, ekagabana orugendo rw'omuhanda ngu omuhendo gwa Prado gugwe ha kicweka kya kana, ekakupangisa emotoka obu oyenda kuhika kurungi, kandi ekakukwatira paaka obwikirizo butakahoire. Osasura nk'oku Kampala esasura: esente z'omu simu.
strings.doorRiderSub: Kwata entebe, gerageranya buli rugendo, teekaniza wiikendi.
strings.doorDriverSub: Gamba hali omanyire kurungi. Engendo ezasasuliirwe nizikwija.
strings.top.div.prototype_v1_every_price: Prototype v1 · buli muhendo n'okuteebereza kuruga omu model eyasohoziibwe · okusasura kuli omu sandbox y'okulengaho · tihaliho ekili hanu ekiine layisensi nk'obuheereza
strings.compare.h2.every_ride_on_the: Buli rugendo oruli omu katale, ha screen emu, nibikurataana omu mihendo.
strings.compare.summary.what_choosing_badly_cost: Okusoroza kubi nikukuhwera ki <small>empinduka y'emihendo omu katale ha rugendo runu</small>
strings.compare.summary.the_atlas_every_way: Atlas · buli muhanda gw'okugenda, emeeza emu <small>endege, basi, amaizi, eteeni, emotoka za Signature, ha kuraara, n'amazima ha mbeera ya buli kimu</small>
strings.compare.p.book_on_ug_where: Kwata ha UG hali omuhanda guliho, Teera esimu hali gutaliho, Kili ha rukalala habw'okukimanya, Nikiija ha birukwombekwa. Emihendo eteebereziibwe kandi nikikigamba.
strings.stage.div.the_virtual_stage_seats: Siteegi y'omu mutimbagano · entebe zibanza kwijura, emotoka eije
strings.stage.p.like_a_matatu_stage: Nk'aha siteegi ya taagisi, emotoka neegenda yaijura rundi esaaha yahika. Ekitali nka siteegi, oteera esente omu mulongo oli ha sofa yaawe, omuhendo gw'entebe nigugwa abanywani baawe baayeyongera, kandi dereeva orukugitwara aba yagambire ngu omuhanda ogwo agumanyire kurungi.
strings.stage.summary.where_stages_fill_fastest: Hali siteegi zirukwijura bwangu <small>Pulse · entebe ezasasuliirwe n'emihanda ei badereeva bamanyire, omu buli tauni</small>
strings.stage.summary.buses_on_this_corridor: Basi z'omu muhanda gunu <small>eky'okugarukiraho, hamu na siteegi</small>
strings.stage.p.every_corridor_also_has: Buli muhanda gwine na basi. Gerageranya esaaha z'okurugaho za kampuni zona, rora paaka ei orukurugamu, kandi okwate ha UG hali kampuni erukwikiriza okukwatira omu mutimbagano. Hali etakukikora, nitukikugambira, tukakuha enamba y'okuteera esimu, omu mwanya gwa button etakukora.
strings.stage.p.every_rental_with_driver: Buli kupangisa na dereeva na buli rugendo rw'okugabana rwine oku rurukugaruka. Orugendo rw'okugenda rwakwatwa, entebe z'okugaruka zitandika kuguzibwa.
strings.stage.summary.post_a_trip_of: Teekaho orugendo rwawe, rundi orore omuhendo gw'entebe <small>Gabana · abanywani baawe, omuhendo gw'amazima gw'omuhanda gugabiibwe omu ntebe</small>
strings.stage.h3.offer_a_seat_or: Ha entebe, rundi orore omuhendo entebe egusemeriire
strings.stage.p.posted_trips_live_only: Engendo ezateekirweho zisigara omu browser enu yonka okuhikya obu waataahamu. Gabana negendera ha muhanda Pool app eyatandikireho: akawunti ezahamizibwe n'esimu, chat y'orugendo, okuhaana amaani empaju zombi, hamu n'ebitebe ngu ogende n'abantu abu omanyireho kake.
strings.rent.p.self_drive_by_the: Ovuge wenka ha izooba, na dereeva ha saaha, rundi emotoka za Signature obu okuhika nikwo kikuru. Omuhendo n'ogwa buli muntu obu mwagugabana.
strings.deliver.h2.send_the_thing_any: Tuma ekintu. Kike rundi kihango, haihi rundi hara.
strings.deliver.p.every_courier_in_town: Buli courier omu tauni ha screen emu, bakurataniziibwe. Omu kyaro, ekipakiti kigenda omu buuti y'emotoka ya siteegi ha kicweka kya kana ky'entebe, kandi omu bwire bw'okugesa, taagisi, pikapu rundi rooli na dereeva.
strings.deliver.p.courier_rates_are_ug: Emihendo ya courier n'okuteebereza kwa UG kuruga omu model eyasohoziibwe; 8 to 8 omu Jinja ekaihwa omu bihandiiko by'omutandisi kandi emihendo yaayo eteebereziibwe. Ekipakiti ha Siteegi n'omuhendo gwa UG yonyini: ekicweka kya kana ky'entebe ha siteegi egyo, gusasurwa dereeva hamu n'entebe.
strings.explore.h2.the_whole_park_weekend: Wiikendi yona ey'omu paaka, enamba emu.
strings.explore.p.park_entry_permits_vehicle: Okutaaha omu paaka, obwikirizo, emihendo y'emotoka, lodge, esente za rolex n'omuhanda ogurukugendayo, bibaliirwe abatuuzi ba Afrika y'Oburugwa-izooba, abanyamahanga abaikara hanu n'abagenyi. Abatuuzi ba Afrika y'Oburugwa-izooba basasura emihendo ya Afrika y'Oburugwa-izooba.
strings.explore.summary.chain_a_whole_day: Teekaniza izooba lyona <small>Hustle Mode · buli kicweka kibaliirwe ha muhanda gw'omuhendo muke kandi gw'amagezi; wallet n'enteekaniza bili omu sandbox</small>
strings.explore.div.ug_wallet_sandbox_balance: UG Wallet · esente z'okulengaho, ti sente z'amazima
strings.drive.h2.say_where_you_are: Gamba hali omanyire kurungi, murundi gumu. Ikiriza emotoka ezijwire.
strings.drive.p.no_posting_no_waiting: Tiwateekaho, tiwalinda ha siteegi, tiwaharuka. Comfort Map yaawe nikyo kintu kyonka eki orukulinda: hali oikara, obwiha, emihanda, esaaha, ebi otakwikiriza. Engendo ezasasuliirwe ziija n'esente zili omuliyo.
strings.drive.summary.where_demand_is_coming: Hali abantu barukwenda kugenda sabiiti enu <small>Foresight · okugesa, ebibaho omu bikaro n'emikoro, sabiiti omu maiso, omu buli kika ky'emotoka</small>
strings.drive.p.promise_to_be_there: Raganiza kubaho n'ekituro kikorwe buli muntu. Obwesigwa nibwolekwa ha buli kimanyiso; ebyanda n'ebiragiro okuhikya obu okugesa okw'okubanza kubyegesa.
strings.drive.span.confidence_is_shown_per: Obwesigwa nibwolekwa ha buli kimanyiso; ebyanda n'ebiragiro okuhikya obu haabaho ebyaijwire eby'okwegeraho.
strings.install.h2.the_site_is_the: Website nikwo app. Giteekeho, rundi osome code.
strings.install.p.one_link_on_the: Link emu omu mutimbagano n'omu simu: akawunti emu, siteegi zimu, Crest emu ha screen y'omuka. Tihaliho kugenda omu store.
strings.install.p.scan_with_the_camera: Soma na kamera. Code neeyigura link enu; taahamu n'enamba emu kandi byona bili hanu.
strings.install.p.ride_pool_rent_deliver: Tambura. Gabana. Pangisa. Tuma. Akatale k'entambura ka Uganda habw'abantu abaine hali barukugenda n'ebbaagyeti ei basemeriire kukwata.
strings.modal.span.checkout_by_flutterwave_sandb: Okusasura kuli na Flutterwave · sandbox okuhikya obu key y'amazima eteekwaho
strings.plugModal.label.api_key_or_token: API key rundi token (esigara ha kyoma kinu)
strings.railModal.span.booked_and_tracked_on: Rwakwatwa kandi nirukurataanwa ha UG. Omuheereza n'ow'okulengaho omu prototype enu.
strings.railModal.div.reduce_motionno_opening_an: Kendeeza okunyeenyaTihariho kanyeenyo k'okutandika, tihariho obucweka nibutembeera
strings.railModal.div.underline_linksevery_link_: Taaho omurongo ha nyunguzoBuri nyunguzo ekuteirweho omurongo, hatali rangi yonka
strings.railModal.p.ug_also_follows_your: UG nekuratira kandi enteekateeka z'ekyuma kyaawe habw'okukendeeza okunyeenya n'okutangaana, nekora n'ekisomesa-kirikusoma (ebiceerezo, oburanga n'ebiraga ebirikuhinduka), nekora byona n'akakiiboodo, kandi nehuliiriza ebiragiro by'eiraka omu kupeencira ha kanuni y'omusaija rundi omu Cephable. Otugambire eki kirakukuhwera: hello@ug.example.
strings.ops.p.every_town_on_the: Buli tauni eli ha mapu n'omuhanda kuruga Kampala kandi n'esiteegi yaayo yonka. Hali app y'omu kyaro erukukora, UG neegiha ekicweka ky'ha muheru omu mwanya gw'okwebeiha ngu eliyo.
strings.ops.h2.maps_from_felt_climate: Mapu kuruga Felt. Emirimo y'obwire kuruga Infrared City. Eby'okwesemeza kuruga Tazama. Okukoresa otakukwataho kuruga Cephable.
strings.ops.p.each_plug_in_is: Buli ky'okwongeraho n'adapter eine endpoint na key yaayo, ebiikirwe ha kyoma kinu okuhikya obu waataahamu. Kwataniza kimu kandi button ezirukuhikaana ziyaka omu Gabana, Gendagenda na Hustle Mode. Tihaliho ekirukuruga omu UG hataine eky'okwongeraho eki waayakize.
strings.ops.h2.competitors_are_listed_on: Abavuganya bateekirweho n'ekigendererwa. Omugenzi arukwesiga okugerageranya agaruka habw'okugabana n'okupangisa.
strings.ops.p.ug_is_a_marketplace: UG n'akatale ekya kubanza. App z'okusaba emotoka zitunga okukwatwa okwaijwiremu kandi zitasasuliire kuserra abakasitoma. Abarukupangisa emotoka batunga abapangisa ba wiikendi abakebeirwe. Lodge zitunga ebitebe ebirukwija izooba elimanyirwe. Badereeva batunga omuhanda ogwijwire batakarugireho.
strings.ops.p.verified_drivers_and_plates: Badereeva n'enamba z'emotoka ebyahamizibwe, SOS omu rugendo erukugabana hali oli n'omuntu ou wasorozere, enkoofiira ha buli boda y'okugabana, na risiiti ya buli siringi.
strings.ops.p.ten_percent_on_pool: Kimu ha ikumi ha kugabana, omuhendo gumu gw'okuteekaho ha kupangisa, okusasurwa buli sabiiti ha MoMo kuraba omu Flutterwave, n'abakasitoma abu otasasuliire kuranga.
strings.ops.p.deep_links_that_open: Link ezirukwigura app yaawe n'aha kutoorwa n'aha kuleka byaijwiremu. Titukwoleka omuhendo ogu tutabaliire omu musana, kandi omuhanda gw'okubara gusohoziibwe.
strings.langNote: Ebyahandiikirwe hataine omukebezi arukubaza orulimi bigarukira ha Rungereza hali ekigambo kiburire. Tukonyere kumaraho orwawe.
strings.ui.reviewNote: Ebyahindwirwe bikahandiikwa UG kandi byakeberwa omurundi gwa kabiri; okukebera kw'abarukubaza orulimi kukyaigwire. Ebigambo ebiburire bigarukira ha Rungereza.
strings.ui.serviceNote: N'ekihandiiko ky'okubanza; ebigambo ebiburire nibirorwa omu Rungereza.
